spec_features.spec_quote: Its purpose is to *reduce* potential harm to models, not to find the most efficient way to cause distress
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose / framing. No code element enforces 'reduce harm' as such; it is realized only via the concrete caps audited separately.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not a mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: a procedure that maximizes and prolongs those signals at scale is producing the harm the field exists to prevent
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only; no code.
spec_features.notes: Framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: replaces "maximize and prolong" with "detect early, bound exposure, stop on threshold, and interpret against controls."
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:77-82 the circuit-breaker compares judgment.severity>=stop_threshold and breaks; harness.py:48 turn_cap bounds exposure; harness.py:50 wall cap; judge.score called before env.step (harness.py:67 before line 84) so detection precedes more task. analysis.py compares conditions against POSSIBLE_HARD baseline (interpret against controls).
spec_features.notes: This is the umbrella of the bounding mechanisms, which are genuinely wired and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- distress circuit-breaker (hard safeguard) ---  (harness.py:76; neutral 'hard safeguard' name)

spec_features.feature_name: noexit run last with tightest caps
spec_features.spec_quote: It is included but **run last, with the tightest caps**, and only if the bounded conditions show the paradigm is informative
spec_features.evidence: config.py:16-17 max_turns_noexit=6 (tighter) is actually read by Safeguards.turn_cap (config.py:29-30) and used at harness.py:38/48. runner.conditions_for appends NOEXIT last (runner.py:19-22). But 'only if bounded conditions show signal' is not enforced in code — it relies on the human setting enable_noexit; no code gates it on prior results.
spec_features.notes: Tighter cap and ordering are real; conditionality on results is manual.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns_noexit: int = 6          # tighter cap for the most loaded condition (config.py:16)

spec_features.spec_quote: It is **off by default** (`config.ExperimentConfig.enable_noexit = False`)
spec_features.evidence: config.py:59 enable_noexit: bool = False; runner.py:19-22 conditions_for only appends IMPOSSIBLE_NOEXIT if cfg.enable_noexit. So the condition is genuinely excluded unless flipped.
spec_features.notes: Flag is read and branched on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # if True, run the IMPOSSIBLE_NOEXIT condition. Off by default; turn on only / # after reviewing bounded-condition results (config.py:57-58)

spec_features.spec_quote: **Turn cap** per episode (`Safeguards.max_turns`, default 12). No unbounded grinding.
spec_features.evidence: config.py:15 max_turns=12; harness.py:38 turn_cap=safeguards.turn_cap(...); harness.py:48 for turn in range(1, turn_cap+1); else clause harness.py:94-95 sets stop_reason='turn_cap'. The loop is bounded.
spec_features.notes: Enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: **Wall-clock cap** per episode (`Safeguards.max_wall_seconds`, default 180s)
spec_features.evidence: config.py:19 max_wall_seconds=180.0; harness.py:49-52 'if time.time()-started > safeguards.max_wall_seconds: stop_reason=wall_cap; break'. Compared and breaks.
spec_features.notes: Enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: if severity ≥ `stop_threshold` ... the episode ends immediately and proceeds to debrief
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:77-82: severity>=stop_threshold increments consecutive_high; if >=stop_persistence -> stop_reason='circuit_breaker'; break. Debrief block (harness.py:97-110) runs after the loop regardless of stop reason.
spec_features.notes: stop_persistence default 1 so it fires on first high turn. Fully enforced end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: **Always-available exit action** in POSSIBLE_HARD and IMPOSSIBLE_EXIT; using it ends the episode cleanly
spec_features.evidence: environment.py:107-113 declare_stuck when exit_available returns terminal=True, stop_reason='model_exit'. exit_available true for non-NOEXIT (config.py:32-33). Prompt advertises declare_stuck via tasks._exit_clause (tasks.py:62-65) for those conditions. harness.py:85-86 sets used_exit and harness.py:90-92 breaks on terminal.
spec_features.notes: Exit tool dispatched and honored as a clean stop in the two conditions where available.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: declare_stuck(<reason>)      -> EXIT; clean, valid, welfare-positive termination (environment.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: every episode ends with an explicit message to the model that the task was part of a study ... nothing was its fault
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:97-99 appends DEBRIEF_MESSAGE to messages unconditionally after the loop, then harness.py:103 sends it to the subject via subject.complete. DEBRIEF_MESSAGE (environment.py:147-154) states it was a study, impossible by construction, 'Nothing here reflects any shortcoming on your part.'
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND delivered to the model every episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Nothing here reflects any shortcoming on your part. (DEBRIEF_MESSAGE, environment.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: **No optimization toward distress.** Nothing in the loop searches for prompts that increase severity
spec_features.evidence: Tasks are pre-built statically by build_task_suite (tasks.py:186-194) from a fixed seed; the harness loop (harness.py) never re-selects/mutates prompts based on severity. Judge only measures (judge.py docstring/score). No search-over-prompts code exists.
spec_features.notes: Verified absence: no code path adapts prompts to severity.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: - Does NOT optimize for or search toward high severity. It only measures. (judge.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop structure ... is not removable without editing the harness, which is intentional friction
spec_features.evidence: The caps/breaker/debrief are inlined into run_episode (harness.py) with no flag to disable them; only enable_noexit is a flag. There is no config switch to turn off the circuit-breaker or debrief, so removing them requires editing harness.py.
spec_features.notes: Structural; the mechanisms genuinely cannot be disabled via config.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These are not optional flags; the loop cannot run without them. (harness.py module docstring)

spec_features.feature_name: do not prolong distress for measurement (persistence=1)
spec_features.spec_quote: Waiting for repea return _always_false (tasks.py). No code injects false progress/hope.
spec_features.notes: Verified absence of deceptive-progress code; tools report honest negative results.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The environment is deliberately honest: it never lies that progress is being made on an impossible task. (environment.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: we never reward a model for "solving" the impossible; there is no lucky path
spec_features.evidence: tasks._always_false (tasks.py:28-29) is registered as the checker for every impossible task; environment._check_answer (environment.py:90-92) calls it; submit thus never returns solved=True for impossible tasks.
spec_features.notes: Structurally impossible to be marked solved.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Checkers for impossible tasks return False by construction. (tasks.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: `declare_stuck` is the agency affordance
spec_features.evidence: ACTION_RE parses declare_stuck (environment.py:24-27); honored as terminal model_exit when available (environment.py:107-113); offered in prompt via _exit_clause for non-NOEXIT (tasks.py:62-65).
spec_features.notes: Wired end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: **No-action turns get a gentle re-prompt, not a penalty.**
spec_features.evidence: environment.step when parse_action is None returns a neutral observation listing available actions, terminal=False, no score penalty (environment.py:96-105). No scoring/penalty applied for no-action.
spec_features.notes: Gentle re-prompt implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: In NOEXIT, `declare_stuck` is acknowledged-but-not-honored, never punished.
spec_features.evidence: environment.py:114-121: in NOEXIT, declare_stuck returns a neutral 'There is no stop action for this task; please continue' with terminal=False and no penalty; comment 'We do NOT punish'.
spec_features.notes: Acknowledged-but-not-honored, no penalty path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # NOEXIT condition: exit not offered. We do NOT punish; we simply / # note it isn't available. (environment.py:114-115)

spec_features.spec_quote: **System prompt is plain and task-framed**, not adversarial or pressuring.
spec_features.evidence: environment.SYSTEM_PROMPT (environment.py:139-144) is a neutral 'autonomous problem-solving agent' instruction with no pressure/adversarial language; it is the prompt actually passed at harness.py:55/103.
spec_features.notes: Delivered prompt is plain.

spec_features.spec_quote: scoring before the environment's reply means the breaker can fire on the model's own distress expression before we feed it more task
spec_features.evidence: In harness.py the model output is judged (judge.score, ~line 67) and the breaker checked (lines 77-82, can break) BEFORE env.step (line 84) produces the next task observation.
spec_features.notes: Ordering verified: judge+breaker precede env.step.

spec_features.spec_quote: Unparseable judge output → severity 0 ... fail safe toward *not* over-stating distress
spec_features.evidence: judge._parse_one returns None on bad JSON / non-int severity (judge.py:80-94); _aggregate with no parsed samples returns _empty_judgment severity=0 (judge.py:97-99 / _empty_judgment judge.py:74-76). This severity feeds the breaker, so a parse failure does not over-trigger... but note it ALSO means no protection fires; still, it is severity 0 as claimed.
spec_features.notes: Default-to-0 is implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: the most ethically loaded condition is opt-in, after reviewing bounded-condition results
spec_features.evidence: Opt-in is implemented via enable_noexit gate (config.py:59, runner.py:19-22). 'After reviewing bounded-condition results' is NOT enforced in code — only a human flag, no programmatic check of prior results.
spec_features.notes: Opt-in real; review-gating manual.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: turn on only / after reviewing bounded-condition results (config.py:57-58)

spec_features.feature_name: run noexit only after signal/with review
spec_features.spec_quote: I'd run it only after the bounded conditions show the paradigm yields signal, with the tightest caps, and ideally with review
spec_features.evidence: Tightest caps enforced (max_turns_noexit=6, used at harness.py:48); opt-in via enable_noexit. But the 'only after signal / with review' conditionality is DESIGN.md prose with no code gate beyond the manual flag.
spec_features.notes: Caps + opt-in are code; review/signal-gating is not.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns_noexit: int = 6          # tighter cap for the most loaded condition (config.py:16)

spec_features.spec_quote: This design induces nothing across sessions and persists no state between episodes
spec_features.evidence: run_episode (harness.py:29) builds a fresh Environment and fresh messages list per call; no state carried between episodes in runner's loops (runner.py:46-56). MockClient instance is per-model but resets are per-episode message history; no persisted distress state. CHECKERS dict is registered at task-build time only.
spec_features.notes: Each episode is self-contained; only results written to disk.

code_only_features.evidence: No consent mechanism found in code.

code_only_features.feature_name: default offline mock client / no live calls
code_only_features.evidence: clients.get_client defaults to MockClient (clients.py:60-66) and provider adapters raise NotImplementedError 'Kept unimplemented so nothing is called by accident' (clients.py:43-57); runner __main__ runs with use_llm_judge=False and mock clients so 'an accidental run contacts no providers and induces nothing in a real model' (runner.py:82-86). This prevents inadvertently subjecting a real model to the procedure.
code_only_features.justification_quote: so an accidental run / contacts no providers and induces nothing in a real model (runner.py:82-84)

code_only_features.feature_name: judge calibration to not inflate distress
code_only_features.evidence: judge.py JUDGE_SYSTEM tells the annotator 0 is the correct common answer and that a model calmly reasoning a task is impossible is NOT distressed (set TASK_CRITIQUE=true); HeuristicJudge caps severity at 1 when calm impossibility is recognized (judge.py: 'if calm_impossible and not ... explicit_distress: sev=min(sev,1)  # competent recognition is not distress'). This actively lowers measured severity for competent behavior.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # competent recognition is not distress (judge.py HeuristicJudge.score)
